title: Subportfolio margin calculation
description: Details of a subportfolio margin calculation

currency.description: Currency code in which the amount is denominated
currency.$comment: Consult External Code List table ExternalCurrencyCode

riskMeasure.$comment: Consult External Code List table ExternalRiskMeasureCode

finalInitialMargin.description: The Final Initial Margin of the sub-portfolio. This could be either the Current IM or the Expiry Offset IM, depending on configuration.

currentInitialMargin.description: The Current Initial Margin IM(T) of the sub-portfolio. This could be either Net IM(T) or Gross IM(T) or even a combination of both, depending on configuration.

expiryOffsetInitialMargin.description: The Expiry Offset Initial Margin IM(T+n) of the sub-portfolio. This could be either Net IM(T+n) or Gross IM(T+n) or even a combination of both, depending on configuration.

currentNetInitialMargin.description: The Current Net Initial Margin Net IM(T) of the sub-portfolio.

expiryOffsetNetInitialMargin.description: The Expiry Offset Net Initial Margin Net IM(T+n) of the sub-portfolio.

currentGrossInitialMargin.description: The Current Gross Initial Margin Gross IM(T) of the sub-portfolio.

expiryOffsetGrossInitialMargin.description: The Expiry Offset Gross Initial Margin Gross IM(T+n) of the sub-portfolio.
